title: Complaint
description: The citizen's report. The busiest collection and the one the admin panel cares about most. PRD-2 section 3.3.
x-reads: userapp: own only, scoped by the deviceId claim
driverapp: wards in the current trip only
adminpanel: within the live staff ward scope

deviceId.description: The citizen's install id. THEIR ONLY KEY. The read rule compares it against the deviceId claim. Never a client parameter.

photoUrl.description: Storage path complaints/{complaintId}/photo.jpg. Compressed under 500 KB.

location.description: Where the citizen saw the problem.

createdAt.description: A SERVER timestamp. The complaint's age drives escalation, so a client clock would break escalation.

assignedTo.description: The staff doc id this complaint is assigned to.

mergedInto.description: The ticket this one was merged into. Null normally. Set by mergeDuplicates.
